classification.difficultyReason: Read three marked locations on a supplied number line and round to tenths, including a midpoint.

content.prompt: Use the number line to round each number to 1 decimal place

spec.description: Number line from 3 to 4 with every tenth labelled. Three downward red arrows have lowercase labels a, b and c.
spec.mathematics: a is between 3.3 and 3.4, nearer 3.4; b is halfway between 3.7 and 3.8; c is between 3.9 and 4, nearer 3.9. Arrow coordinates reconstruct source-relative positions and do not assert exact unprinted input values.
spec.answerVisibility: Input arrows and their labels are permanent givens. Rounded answers are absent.

answer.worked: The arrow is between $3.3$ and $3.4$, closer to $3.4$. Rounded to 1 decimal place, the number is $3.4$.
The arrow is halfway between $3.7$ and $3.8$. Round up at halfway, giving $3.8$ to 1 decimal place.
The arrow is between $3.9$ and $4$, closer to $3.9$. Rounded to 1 decimal place, the number is $3.9$.
